name: report_call
description: For outbound calls only; never use for inbound calls. The only way to end a call where attempt_id has a value. Report everything this person told you, whatever they were asked, including when the answer is that they are safe. Call it once, just before the call ends. Never use record_check_in on these calls.

answer.description: Their complete account in their own words, preserving corrections, uncertainty and refusal. Submit once; an exact retry must keep the same account.

concern.description: Anything that felt off: they asked for someone's address or phone number, you could not verify who they were, or their story did not add up. Empty string if nothing did.
